q1_issues.issue: The sealed `Implication`'s premise names Skolem constants that nothing asserts (`sk_pass_1`, and `sk_person_1` typed inside the premise itself), violating "rule premises bind through plain variables" — such a rule can never match or fire.

`(Stimulus sk_watch_1 sk_person_1)` mis-slots an ENTITY object of "watch": Thematic roles lists watch among the `Theme` verbs and reserves `Stimulus` for a psych state's object or a perception report's eventive complement.

q2_gaps: second-person "you" as a referent — the pronoun/coreference rules enumerate only he/she/it/they, so neither the class nor the number of an antecedentless "you" is specified

a one-off indicative conditional over specific/definite participants ("If you pass this bill, ...") — the `Implication` route presupposes plain-variable premises, leaving no licensed form for a conditional whose antecedent names specific witnesses
party/district tag "D-Waco" — no licensed head; the instruction set registers this and the parse correctly leaves it out, so the information is lost
notes: The direct-quotation routing (say event, `Experiencer` holder, complement sealed under `Theme`, definite "this bill" projected to top level, `Future` + `Ongoing` on the watching) follows the instruction set. Keeping "Rep." inside the `Name` string is defensible as a courtesy title rather than an occupational premodifier.
